page.content:
Nuclear war that ended the old world and made Ooo.

How Mushroom War connects

  • Character: The Lich — The Lich is born from the Mushroom War's bomb.
  • Location: Land of Ooo — The Mushroom War is what left the world that became Ooo.

What is Mushroom War?

The Mushroom War is the human apocalypse whose craters, mutants, and bomb-birth of the Lich sit under every candy kingdom.

Key threads lead to The Lich and Land of Ooo.
